heading: Cache changes run after success
body: UpdateCache and ClearCache accept {method: 'find', arguments: [0]}, written in strict JSON in annotations. The target is a Cached method in the same class. arguments maps the parameter positions of the mutation method to the raw arguments of the target. The mutation method is the method that changes data. The mutation reuses the pagination, key selection, Cache namespace, TTL (time to live) and limits of the target. Tachyon checks authorization (cache:put or cache:evict), adapter availability and keys before application code runs. The set or delete happens only after the output succeeds within its limits. The output must also pass the cancellation and deadline checks. Put never reads the cache. A failure does not change the cache. This is not an atomic (all or nothing) transaction across the database and the cache. If a database change succeeds and the cache adapter then fails, the application must still fix the difference. A mutation cannot have its own @PageDefaults. It can combine with an HTTP request annotation, which provides its successful result.
